purpose: Compile public demand, reusable assets, agent capabilities and economic outcomes into new sellable cells without requiring a new platform for each cell.

cross_pollination.game_to_avatar: player/world achievement becomes cosmetic or identity asset
cross_pollination.game_to_dooh: game telemetry selects creative/context for authorized placement
cross_pollination.dooh_to_game: QR/shortlink/offer resolves into a playable sandbox or paid item
cross_pollination.api_to_game: paid API capability becomes a game mechanic or creator tool
cross_pollination.game_to_api: game-generated demand becomes an API offer or service cell

economic_rule: GPU work is capital only when the output is retained as a reusable artifact, measurable advantage, or paid fulfillment. Otherwise classify it as compute expense.

agentic_commerce.protocol_strategy: remain protocol-neutral at the artifact layer; adapt at the edge to MCP/A2A/commerce/payment protocols

first_test: Compile one public demand signal into one reusable digital artifact, expose one paid toll or digital item, and retain the resulting evidence for the next compilation cycle.
